description: Company Consumer Products Limited (CCPL) Financial Pack - P&L data across different time aggregations and regions

domain_context.business_type: Consumer products company with operations across India, SAARC, GAUM, LATAM, and Indonesia
domain_context.data_purpose: Financial performance tracking and analysis across different geographies and time periods
domain_context.currency_logic: Non-Indian businesses shown in both local currency (LC/CC) and INR . Default to INR unless explicitly requested otherwise. INR conversion uses simple average of opening and closing FX rates.

reporting_types.reported: Current period exactly as booked vs. last period exactly as booked
reporting_types.organic: Like-for-like comparison that strips out sold/acquired businesses for clean growth comparison

financial_hierarchy: net_sales_ind_as (NSV - True revenue after trade discounts)
throughput (GC minus BTL - unavoidable margin once you sell)
operational_ebitda_nsv (NC minus Fixed O/H plus Other Income)

quarterly.selection_logic: When user specifies quarter (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4) without 'to date', use quarter table by default

table_precedence.explicit_table_mention: If user explicitly mentions table name (e.g., 'from quarter table'), use that table
table_precedence.time_period_keywords: If user mentions Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 without 'to date', default to quarter table
table_precedence.cumulative_keywords: If user mentions 'to date', 'cumulative', or 'YTD'/'QTD', use respective cumulative tables
table_precedence.default_fallback: If no clear indicators, default to ftm for monthly data

ftm.selection_logic: Use base metric name unless user specifically asks for percentage

qtd.selection_logic: Default to _qtd_val for actual values. Use _qtd_aop for budget/AOP/plan queries. Use _qtd_aop_iya for year-over-year/growth queries

ytd.selection_logic: Default to __val for actual values. Use __aop for budget/AOP/plan queries. Use __aop_iya for year-over-year/growth queries

quarter.selection_logic: Default to _aop for budget values (quarter table only has budget data). Use _aop_iya for year-over-year/growth queries

fy.selection_logic: Default to _val for actual values. Use _aop for budget/AOP/plan queries. Use _aop_iya for year-over-year/growth queries

half.selection_logic: Half table only has growth indices (_aop_iya). Used for half-yearly year-over-year comparisons

example_queries.natural_language: Show me net sales for India Q3 2024
example_queries.correct_sql: SELECT quarter, net_sales_ind_as_aop AS value FROM quarter WHERE year = 2024 AND quarter = 'Q3' AND region IN ('CCPL India Cluster','India Standalone')
example_queries.explanation: Q3 indicator maps to quarter table, which only has budget data (_aop suffix)

example_queries.natural_language: Show me net sales for India Q3 2024 from quarter table
example_queries.correct_sql: SELECT quarter, net_sales_ind_as_aop AS value FROM quarter WHERE year = 2024 AND quarter = 'Q3' AND region IN ('CCPL India Cluster','India Standalone')
example_queries.explanation: Quarter table only has budget data, so use _aop suffix

example_queries.natural_language: What was actual net sales QTD for India in Oct 2024?
example_queries.correct_sql: SELECT month, net_sales_ind_as_qtd_val AS value FROM qtd WHERE year = 2024 AND month = 'Oct' region IN ('CCPL India Cluster','India Standalone')
example_queries.explanation: QTD table with 'actual' keyword maps to _qtd_val suffix

example_queries.natural_language: Show me Q3 2024 net sales quarter to date
example_queries.correct_sql: SELECT month, net_sales_ind_as_qtd_val AS value FROM qtd WHERE year = 2024 AND month IN ('Jul','Aug','Sep')
example_queries.explanation: 'quarter to date' explicitly indicates QTD table

example_queries.natural_language: How did EBITDA grow YTD vs last year?
example_queries.correct_sql: SELECT month, ebitda__aop_iya AS value FROM ytd
example_queries.explanation: Growth/YoY queries use _aop_iya suffix for year-over-year index

example_queries.natural_language: Show budget vs actual EBITDA QTD
example_queries.correct_sql: SELECT month, ebitda_qtd_val AS actual, ebitda_qtd_aop AS budget FROM qtd
example_queries.explanation: Budget vs actual requires both _qtd_val and _qtd_aop columns

tables.name: ftm
tables.description: For-The-Month (FTM) P&L data - Monthly financial performance metrics

domain_mapping.Reported: Current period vs last period as booked

gross_sales.description: Gross Sales Value (GSV) - Invoice value to distributors before any discount
gross_sales.business_definition: Invoice value to distributors before any discount

net_sales_igaap.business_definition: Net sales calculated per Indian GAAP standards

less_ind_as_btl_adjustment.business_definition: Below-the-line adjustments for Ind AS compliance

net_sales_ind_as.description: Net Sales (NSV) under Ind AS - True revenue after trade discounts
net_sales_ind_as.business_definition: True revenue after trade discounts; use this for 'sales' answers

cost_of_goods_sold.description: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) - Direct material, packaging and labour
cost_of_goods_sold.business_definition: Direct material, packaging and labour costs

gross_contribution_gc_of_gsv.business_definition: GSV minus COGS; GC % = GC ÷ GSV

gross_contribution_gc_forex_of_gsv.business_definition: Gross contribution adjusted for foreign exchange impact

throughput.description: Throughput - GC minus BTL; margin you cannot avoid once you decide to sell
throughput.business_definition: GC minus BTL; effectively the margin you cannot avoid once you decide to sell

atl.description: Above The Line (ATL) - Brand advertising spend

working_media.description: Working Media - Airtime spend component of ATL
working_media.business_definition: Airtime spend; Non-working covers production and agency fees

btl_incl_tpr_ind_as_btl_adj.description: Below The Line (BTL) including TPR - Trade spend and incentives
btl_incl_tpr_ind_as_btl_adj.business_definition: Incentives given to distributors and retailers

net_contribution_nc.description: Net Contribution (NC) - Throughput minus ATL and VC
net_contribution_nc.business_definition: Throughput minus ATL and VC; lowest level that can be broken out by brand or category

manpower_expenses_ex_plvr_lti.description: Manpower expenses excluding PLVR and LTI
manpower_expenses_ex_plvr_lti.business_definition: Basic salary and wage costs excluding performance bonuses and long-term incentives

total_manpower.description: Total Manpower costs - Salaries, PLVR bonus and one-off retention schemes
total_manpower.business_definition: Salaries, PLVR bonus and one-off retention schemes

non_manpower_expenses.description: Non-manpower expenses - Rent, utilities, supply-chain admin
non_manpower_expenses.business_definition: All other indirect operating costs (rent, utilities, supply-chain admin)

total_fixed_overheads.description: Total Fixed Overheads - Manpower plus non-manpower costs

other_operating_income.description: Other Operating Income - Sundry items like scrap sales

operational_ebitda_nsv.description: Operational EBITDA - Net Contribution minus Fixed O/H plus Other Income
operational_ebitda_nsv.business_definition: Net Contribution minus Fixed O/H plus Other Income

fx_gain_loss.business_definition: Impact of foreign exchange rate movements

inter_co_re_charges_income_expenses.business_definition: Income and expenses related to inter-company transactions

other_income_expenses.business_definition: Other non-operating income and expense items

operational_ebitda_forex_nsv.business_definition: Operational EBITDA adjusted for foreign exchange impact

operational_ebitda_forex_working_media_n.description: EBITDA + Working Media - Adds back Working Media as brand equity investment
operational_ebitda_forex_working_media_n.business_definition: Adds back Working Media, which CCPL treats as an 'investment' in brand equity

ebitda.description: EBITDA - Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortization
natural_language_aliases: earnings before interest tax depreciation amortization

ebit.description: EBIT - Earnings before interest and tax

net_interest_cost.description: Net Interest Cost - Interest expense minus interest income

profit_after_tax.business_definition: Final profit after all expenses and taxes

profit_after_tax_w_o_exceptional.business_definition: Net profit excluding one-time exceptional items

uvg.description: Underlying Volume Growth - Units growth percentage
